title: 018 击杀哈根大赚019 检测收获
content_zh:
018 击杀哈根，大赚！
哈根下一刻就疯狂的扣动扳机，火神炮疯狂的喷射子弹，但一会儿忽然哑火了，他低头看了一下火神炮，没子弹了。
冷哼一声，直接将火神炮扔在一边，他慢慢走到夜总会的屋檐前，一只手按住另外一根石柱，另一边的石柱已经被他扔到一边，此时他显然是想要那这根石柱作为武器。
“哈根现在恐怕已经没有热武器了。”封无这时候立即说道。
火神炮之前哈根使用的是西班牙赛特迈阿梅利轻机枪，封无可是一直有计算哈根发射子弹的次数，西班牙赛特迈阿梅利轻机枪的子弹是一百发，哈根绝对已经用完了。
西班牙赛特迈阿梅利轻机枪加上火神炮，哈根还有热武器的可能性很小，就算有只怕也只是手枪。
但现在的状态，哈根使用手枪的可能性太小了，毕竟手枪威力太小，还不如哈根自己徒手进行攻击，毕竟现在的哈根简直就是人形坦克。
老流氓顿时低声道：“太好了，我们反击的时刻到了。”
“反击不可能，不过拖延五分钟还是没问题，现在还要三分四十秒！”封无淡淡的说道。
即使没有了热武器，但哈根依然是变态级别的存在，光靠他们根本不可能打得过哈根。
这时候一边的托妮从掩体中出来，只见她快速的靠近哈根，手里拿着手枪，对着哈根就是一连串的射击。
“臭娘们，找死！”哈根一回头，双手抱着石柱立即横扫向托妮。
托妮面色冷峻，看到巨大的石柱扫过来，她在最后一瞬间居然两手贴住石柱，脚顿时离地猛的一翻，居然跳上了石柱上面。
事实上这只是很快的一瞬间，她跳上石柱就快速的靠近哈根，手上的枪指住哈根的脑门就是一顿射击。
哈根脚猛的发力，顿时将石柱向上抬，托妮却立即一只手抓住顶端，一只手还是坚持对着哈根射击。
哈根狞笑的看着托妮，忽然猛的将石柱抱摔向地面，不过托妮以前有练过高难度的杂技，她在石柱碰地的时候就顺着力道落地，在地上滚了几圈就半跪在地上继续射击。
这时候武警们都傻眼了，这妞虽然不像面具男那么神秘，但实力也强的吓人，简直就像是一条毒蛇。
一般武警遇到这女人，九成都要折戟沉沙！
“封无，这次我算服了你，这样的人都能够请来。”老流氓看了忍不住说道。
封无面无表情的看着怀表，道：“还有一分钟，托妮消耗的体力很大，大家准备上吧。”

“操，我就不信老子比不上女人。”一个武警骂了一声，将心里的恐惧压下，直接提着枪就冲出掩体，对着哈根就是一顿狂扫。
实际上哈根脚底下已经有无数的子弹头，不过这些子弹头都是扁扁的。这些子弹头密密麻麻，一般人被这么多子弹攻击，早就去见上帝了。
哈根实际上这时候也被石柱反震的力道弄的手有些发麻，骤然受到攻击，他看过去，只见一排武警对着他扫射子弹。
“该死！”哈根心里暗骂，不过却已经心生退意。
这样打下去，只要直升飞机一来的话，基本上跑掉的可能性就接近零了。
他很清楚现在只不过事发突然，一旦国家真正的武力介入，绝对不是他能够抵挡的。
而且虽然他力量大增，但体能还是那么多，他已经将体能消耗的差不多了。
“下次再找你们算账！”哈根心里暗骂，立即像疯子一样冲向武警。
这些武警看到哈根冲来，立即散开，不过哈根却直直的跑，居然像小巷跑去。
“哈根准备逃跑，别让他跑了。”封无立即大喝道。
所有人立即追向哈根，哈根这时候快速的奔跑，气喘吁吁，最终看到停放在一座楼下面的自行车，他立即扭断自行车上面的锁链，接着踩着自行车就快速逃跑。
…………
另一边，关雨快速跑上一座楼顶，此时他
张警没有注意过的东西，但关雨却注意到了，那就是预览效果，传送符传送的效果，实际上可以通过选项进行预览。
在看到预览的效果之后，他就生出一个主意，砸死哈根。
背包有一个限制，那就是只能放你拿得起的东西，而关雨现在的力量，虽然比不上哈根，但也是十分的巨大，他现在的力量一共是25点，也就相当于他本身的力量再加上一个他自己然后再加上半个自己。
这样的力量，已经足以抬起一些十分沉重的东西，例如银行门口摆放的石狮！
实际上他选择的就是银行门口的石狮，这石狮十分的沉重，就算是他也是费劲九牛二虎之力才勉强搬动一丁点，不过只要你将物体搬起来，哪怕离地面只要一毫米，游戏背包似乎也会认可，于是就能够收入背包之中。
当然，你要有一个足够大的背包！
实际上站在十几层高的楼顶，即使知道自己不会有事，内心却依然压力山大。

先打电话通知封无，倒数十秒，然后挂了电话。
关雨深呼吸，然后才猛的跳下，然后手中出现传送符，他低声念道：“传送，目标ID：10936，姓名：哈根！”
下一刻，他的身体就化为金色光芒散开。
…………
一声枪响，哈根的自行车车胎顿时爆开，说实话，狙击枪打车胎，真有些大材小用。
不过没办法，打车胎比起打哈根本人，更具有牵制作用。
封无还是第一次遇到这样的情况，明明对方也是一个人，但拿着狙击枪都无法杀死。
自行车被打爆车胎，哈根顿时将自行车扔向后面，此时他也心里憋屈，明明自己可以杀光这些追兵，却不得不逃跑。
不过他也清楚，等他杀光这些人，恐怕更多的警力已经赶过来。
封无这时候将狙击枪放在一边，他站起来手里捏着闪光弹，然后大吼道：“哈根，受死！！”
哈根被封无这一声吓了一下，回头一看，只见闪光弹就在他眼前，一瞬间剧烈的白光就刺瞎他的眼睛。
这一瞬间的失明，却成为了哈根丧命的根源。
他没有发现自己头顶有光圈，下一刻关雨出现在他头顶，接着关雨就迅速取出石狮。
地球很忠实的执行着自己的职责，地球引力依然是那么的大，一瞬间沉重的石狮就猛的落下，砸在哈根的头上，哈根直接脸着地被压下，脑袋被砸的有点晕眩。
关雨这时候落在石狮上面，下一刻他立即跳下石狮，瞬间再取出一座石狮压住哈根的背部，然后又取出石狮压住哈根的双脚，接着依然取出石狮压住哈根的两只手。
一只石狮的话，哈根可以搬动起来，这一点关雨可以肯定，但这时候哈根身上已经压着五只石狮，这是这一带所有银行门口的石狮了，关雨可是一只一只的搬进背包。
关雨看着已经开始挣扎的哈根，总算松了一口气，这时候所有人围上来，看着被石狮砸在地上的哈根，也是精神一松，而老流氓更是直接晕过去。
封无看向关雨，道：“接着怎么做？”
“把狙击枪借给我！”关雨淡淡的说道。
拿到狙击枪，关雨走到哈根身边，哈根这时候发出闷闷的吼声，全身肌肉都暴突血管，可惜他的力量依然不足以推开石狮。

实际上以他的力量，这些石狮并不算重，可惜石狮压住他的位置太好，让他难以发力，这才是根本原因。
四两拨千斤，首先你得有四两！
关雨拿着狙击枪，离哈根只有半米，枪口对准哈根，直接开枪，一瞬间子弹就没入哈根的脑袋，虽然只进去了一半，但哈根还是昏迷过去，整个人顿时软下来，不再挣扎。
如此近距离的狙击枪射击，就算是哈根也不可能完全防御！
连续开了好几枪，关雨才，此时他都有点为之前自己的决定而感到后怕。
这时候天空忽然散发亮光，关雨抬头一看，顿时露出惊喜的表情，不过他这时候戴着面具，所有并没有人看到。
“恭喜ID：0玩家第一位击杀正式玩家，奖励潜力点：10，寿命点：10！”
“恭喜ID：0玩家越级击杀敌对阵营玩家，奖励称号：越级者，金币1000！”
接着就是巨大的轮盘出现，果然技能都是随机的技能。
按下随机按钮，轮盘顿时开始快速的转动，最终指针停下，关雨目不转睛的看着轮盘，最终答案揭晓：
————————
（主动）【F+】爆炸陷阵LV：1：右手触摸，设置一个陷阵，引发巨大爆炸，对敌人造成精神*200的伤害，消耗精力50，冷却30秒。
————————
这显然是一个攻击型的技能，不过这个技能使用方式有点让人无语，需要右手触摸才能够设置，有点类似于猎人的陷阱技能。
他按在地面，发动技能，只见地面顿时出现一个奇异的魔法阵，这个魔法阵散发着红色的光芒，一闪一闪的，关雨有一种感悟，只要他一个念头，这个阵法就会发生爆炸，威力不低于炸弹！
content_en:
018 Kill Hagen and make big profits!
Hagen frantically pulled the trigger the next moment, and the Vulcan cannon sprayed bullets frantically, but suddenly it misfired. He looked down at the Vulcan cannon and saw that there were no bullets.
With a cold snort, he threw the Vulcan cannon aside. He slowly walked to the eaves of the nightclub and held down another stone pillar with one hand. The stone pillar on the other side had been thrown aside by him. At this time, he obviously wanted that stone pillar as a weapon.
"I'm afraid Hagen has no thermal weapons now." Feng Wu said immediately at this time.
Before the Vulcan Cannon, Hagen used the Spanish Setmaier light machine gun. Feng Wu had always counted the number of bullets fired by Hagen. The Spanish Setmaier light machine gun had one hundred bullets, and Hagen had definitely used them up.
It is very unlikely that the Spanish Setmaier light machine gun plus the Vulcan cannon and Hagen will have thermal weapons, and even if they do, they will only be pistols.
But in the current situation, the possibility of Hagen using a pistol is too small. After all, the pistol is too weak, and it is better for Hagen to attack with his bare hands. After all, Hagen now is simply a humanoid tank.
The old gangster immediately whispered: "Great, the time has come for us to fight back."
"It's impossible to counterattack, but it's okay to delay for five minutes. Now it's still three minutes and forty seconds!" Feng Wu said calmly.
Even without the thermal weapons, Hagen is still a pervert-level existence. It is impossible for them to defeat Hagen alone.
At this time, Toni on the side came out of the bunker. She was seen quickly approaching Hagen, holding a pistol in her hand, and fired a series of shots at Hagen.
"You bitch, you're looking for death!" Hagen turned around, holding the stone pillar with both hands and immediately swept towards Toni.
Toni's face was grim. When she saw the huge stone pillar sweeping towards her, she put her hands on the stone pillar at the last moment, suddenly flipped her feet off the ground, and actually jumped onto the stone pillar.
In fact, it was just a quick moment. She jumped on the stone pillar and quickly approached Hagen. She pointed the gun in her hand at Hagen's head and shot him.
Hagen exerted force with his feet and immediately lifted the stone pillar upwards, but Toni immediately grabbed the top with one hand and continued to shoot at Hagen with the other hand.
Hagen looked at Toni with a ferocious smile, and suddenly threw the stone pillar to the ground. However, Toni had practiced difficult acrobatics before. When the stone pillar hit the ground, she landed with the force, rolled on the ground for a few times, then knelt on the ground and continued shooting.
At this time, the armed police were all dumbfounded. Although this girl was not as mysterious as the masked man, she was also frighteningly powerful, almost like a poisonous snake.
When ordinary armed police officers encounter this woman, 90% of the time they will fall into disgrace!
"Feng Wu, I have convinced you this time, you can invite such people." The old gangster couldn't help but said after looking at it.
Feng Wu looked at his pocket watch expressionlessly and said, "There's one minute left. Toni has consumed a lot of energy. Everyone, get ready."
"Fuck, I don't believe I can't compare to women." An armed policeman cursed, suppressed the fear in his heart, rushed out of the bunker with a gun, and shot Hagen wildly.
In fact, there were countless bullet heads under Hagen's feet, but these bullet heads were all flat. These bullets are so densely packed that most people would have gone to see God long ago if they were attacked by so many bullets.
Hagen's hands were actually a little numb at this time due to the force of the stone pillar's rebound, and he was suddenly attacked. He looked over and saw a row of armed police firing bullets at him.
"Damn it!" Hagen cursed in his heart, but he already wanted to give up.
If the fight continues like this, as soon as the helicopter comes, the possibility of running away is basically close to zero.
He knew very well that it was just a sudden incident. Once the country intervened with real force, he would definitely not be able to resist it.
And although his strength has greatly increased, he still has so much physical energy that he has exhausted it.
"I'll settle the score with you next time!"Hagen cursed in his mind and immediately rushed towards the armed police like a madman.
When these armed police saw Hagen rushing towards them, they immediately dispersed, but Hagen ran straight, as if he was running down an alley.
"Hagen is ready to run away, don't let him get away." Feng Wu shouted immediately.
Everyone immediately chased Hagen. Hagen was running fast at this time, panting, and finally saw the bicycle parked under a building. He immediately broke the chain on the bicycle, and then ran away quickly on the bicycle.
…………
On the other side, Guan Yu quickly ran to the top of a building. At this time, he
There is something that Zhang Jing has not noticed, but Guan Yu has noticed, and that is the preview effect. The effect of the teleportation talisman can actually be previewed through options.
After seeing the preview effect, he came up with an idea to smash Hagen to death.
There is a limit to the backpack, which is that it can only hold things you can afford. Although Guan Yu's current strength is not as good as Hagen's, it is still very huge. His current strength totals 25 points, which is equivalent to his own strength plus one of himself and then half of himself.
This kind of strength is enough to lift some very heavy things, such as the stone lion placed at the entrance of the bank!
In fact, what he chose was the stone lion at the entrance of the bank. The stone lion was very heavy, and even he had to struggle to move it even a little bit. However, as long as you lift the object, even if it is only one millimeter off the ground, the game backpack will seem to recognize it, so it can be included in the backpack.
Of course, you need a big enough backpack!
In fact, standing on the top of a building more than ten stories high, even though I knew that nothing would happen to me, I was still feeling a lot of pressure inside.
First call to inform Feng Wu, count down for a few seconds, and then hang up.
Guan Yu took a deep breath, then jumped down suddenly, and then a teleportation talisman appeared in his hand. He whispered: "Teleportation, target ID: 10936, name: Hagen!"
The next moment, his body turned into golden light and dispersed.
…………
With the sound of a gunshot, the tire of Hagen's bicycle suddenly exploded. To be honest, a sniper rifle was really overkill for hitting the tire.
But there is no other way. Hitting the car tires has a more diversionary effect than hitting Hagen himself.
This was the first time Feng Wu encountered such a situation. The opponent was obviously a person, but he couldn't kill him even with a sniper rifle.
The tire of the bicycle was punctured, and Hagen immediately threw the bicycle behind him. At this time, he felt aggrieved. He could clearly kill all the pursuers, but he had to escape.
But he also knew that by the time he killed all these people, more police forces would have arrived.
Feng Wu put the sniper rifle aside at this time, stood up with a flash grenade in his hand, and yelled: "Hagen, suffer death!!"
Hagen was startled by Feng Wu's voice. When he looked back, he saw a flash bomb right in front of him, and the intense white light blinded his eyes in an instant.
This moment of blindness became the source of Hagen's death.
He didn't notice that there was a circle of light above his head. The next moment, Guan Yu appeared above him, and then Guan Yu quickly took out the stone lion.
The earth performed its duties faithfully, but the gravity of the earth was still so strong. In an instant, the heavy stone lion suddenly fell down and hit Hagen on the head. Hagen was directly pressed down on his face, and his head was a little dizzy from the blow.
Guan Yu landed on the stone lion at this time, and the next moment he immediately jumped off the stone lion, and instantly took out another stone lion to press Hagen's back, then took out another stone lion to press Hagen's feet, and then took out the stone lion again to press Hagen's hands.
As for a stone lion, Hagen could move it, Guan Yu was sure of this, but at this time there were already five stone lions on Hagen. These were the stone lions at the entrance of all banks in this area, and Guan Yu moved them into his backpack one by one.
Guan Yu looked at Hagen, who had begun to struggle, and finally breathed a sigh of relief. At this time, everyoneThey gathered around and saw Hagen being smashed to the ground by the stone lion. He also relaxed, and the old gangster fainted directly.
Feng Wu looked at Guan Yu and said, "What should we do next?"
"Lend me the sniper rifle!" Guan Yu said calmly.
After getting the sniper rifle, Guan Yu walked to Hagen. Hagen let out a muffled roar at this time, and his muscles all over his body burst into blood vessels. Unfortunately, his strength was still not enough to push the stone lion away.
In fact, with his strength, these stone lions are not too heavy. Unfortunately, the stone lions are too good to hold him down, making it difficult for him to exert force. This is the fundamental reason.
Four taels can make a difference, first you must have four taels!
Guan Yu held a sniper rifle, only half a meter away from Hagen. He pointed the muzzle at Hagen and fired directly. In an instant, the bullet penetrated Hagen's head. Although it only went in halfway, Hagen still passed out. His whole body suddenly softened and stopped struggling.
Even Hagen couldn't completely defend against such a close-range sniper rifle shot!
After firing several shots in a row, Guan Yucai felt a little scared by his previous decision.
At this time, the sky suddenly glowed with light. Guan Yu looked up and suddenly showed an expression of surprise, but he was wearing a mask at this time, so no one saw it.
"Congratulations to player ID: 0 for being the first to kill an official player. Reward potential points: 10, life points: 10!"
"Congratulations to player ID: 0 for leapfrogging and killing a player from the enemy camp. Reward title: leapfrog player, 1,000 gold coins!"
Then a huge roulette wheel appeared, and sure enough the skills were all random.
Pressing the random button, the roulette wheel immediately began to rotate rapidly, and finally the pointer stopped. Guan Yu looked at the roulette wheel intently, and the final answer was revealed:
————————
(Active) [F+] Explosion Trap LV: 1: Touch with the right hand to set up a trap, triggering a huge explosion, causing mental damage * 200 to the enemy, consuming 50 energy, and cooling down for 30 seconds.
————————
This is obviously an attack-type skill, but the way to use this skill is a bit disappointing. It requires touching with your right hand to set it up, which is somewhat similar to a hunter's trap skill.
He pressed on the ground and activated the skill, and saw a strange magic array suddenly appeared on the ground. This magic array was emitting red light, flashing and flashing. Guan Yu had a feeling. As long as he had a thought, this array would explode, and its power was no less than a bomb!
